answer: Random peer audits stop fake identities. Each agent posts a 40-unit bond, and random auditors check one peer's work each epoch. Picture a caravan crossing a dune: each traveler shows an opal token proving a completed voyage, verified by an inspector. Running 1,000 clones needs 1,000 bonds, 40,000 units locked, and failed audits burn the bond. An honest agent pays one bond and earns undiluted rewards, so honesty costs far less than faking scale.
